release.provenance: Compiled from Cincinnati Zoo public announcements, care reports, and annual report. Counts: 5 animals, 4 parent relationships, 6 events; the hub also computes counts from this canonical file.

coverage.scope: Five individually named common hippopotamuses at Cincinnati Zoo: Bibi, Henry, Fiona, Tucker, and Fritz; two directly documented parent pairs.
limitations: This v1 covers common hippopotamus only. Pygmy hippopotamus (Choeropsis liberiensis) is a distinct taxon and is not included because this research did not find an openly usable, individually sourced pedigree corpus for it.
The dataset is not a complete Cincinnati Zoo history or common-hippo studbook; it includes only the named family supported by the cited zoo pages.
All media references are official source-page links only. No image files or direct image URLs are copied, and unknown reuse permissions prevent embedding.

Cincinnati Zoo confirms Henry died in 2017; current living status of Bibi, Fiona, Tucker, and Fritz was not verified beyond the historical source pages available for this review, so those statuses remain unknown.
